title: finish_process_message_3: missing poison on lifecycle check failure
description:
File: crates/oscore/src/edhoc/responder.rs
Line: 455
Function: finish_process_message_3
Category: missing-poison-on-error

## Description
Returns Err(EdhocError::InvalidState) without calling poison() when lifecycle or transcript binding check fails. The pending.transcript_binding originated from peer data processing in begin_process_message_3. While primarily an internal state consistency check, the pending struct contains processed peer data, and failing to poison leaves cryptographic state intact.

## Fix
Call self.poison() before returning at line 455, or restructure to include this check in the closure pattern that follows.
